wars.name: Djiboutian Civil War
wars.outcome: No territorial change: the July 1993 counter-offensive drove FRUD back into the mountains on the Eritrean border, the Abb'a agreement ended the main war on 26 December 1994 and a final agreement with Dini's faction followed on 12 May 2001.

certainty.note: The frontiers are colonial lines; the civil-war page mentions an agreement 'on the definition of its common border' with Ethiopia around 1997 (no exact date).
